cues.text:
hello大家好。好久好久不见了
hello dàjiā hǎo. hǎojiǔ hǎojiǔbujiàn le
Hello everyone. It's been a long, long time.

我好久好久没有录vlog了
wǒ hǎojiǔ hǎojiǔ méiyǒu lù vlog le
I haven't recorded a vlog in ages.

那这几天
nà zhèjǐtiān
So, these past few days

我在进行一个短途旅行
wǒ zài jìnxíng yígè duǎn tú lǔxíng
I've been on a short trip.

我在镇江
wǒ zài zhènjiāng
I'm in Zhenjiang.

这个地方在上海的西北部
zhège dìfāng zài shànghǎi de xīběibù
This place is northwest of Shanghai.

离上海坐火车大概只要一个半小时
lí shànghǎi zuò huǒchē dàgài zhǐyào yígè bànxiǎoshí
It's only about an hour and a half from Shanghai by train.

我住的酒店就在镇江
wǒ zhù de jiǔdiàn jiù zài zhènjiāng
The hotel I'm staying at is right next to

最著名的一个景点旁边
zuì zhùmíng de yígè jǐngdiǎn pángbiān
Zhenjiang's most famous scenic spot.

这个景点叫做西津渡
zhège jǐngdiǎn jiàozuò xī jīn dù
This spot is called Xijindu — West Ferry Crossing.

在古代是一个渡口
zài gǔdài shì yígè dùkǒu
In ancient times it was a ferry crossing,

所以镇江在古代其实挺重要的
suǒyǐ zhènjiāng zài gǔdài qíshí tǐng zhòngyào de
so Zhenjiang was actually quite important back then.

但我猜你们现在应该
dàn wǒ cāi nǐmen xiànzài yīnggāi
But I'd guess that these days

没有多少人听过这个城市
méiyǒu duōshǎo rén tīng guò zhège chéngshì
not many of you have heard of this city.

所以今天我就想带你们一起看一看
suǒyǐ jīntiān wǒ jiù xiǎng dài nǐmen yīqǐ kànyīkàn
So today I want to take you along to have a look.

西津渡现在是一个
xī jīn dù xiànzài shì yígè
Xijindu is now a place

像商业古街一样的地方
xiàng shāngyè gǔ jiē yīyàng de dìfāng
rather like a commercial old street.

其实这样的古街
qíshí zhèyàng de gǔ jiē
Actually, old streets like this

现在在中国很多景点都非常常见
xiànzài zài zhōngguó hěn duō jǐngdiǎn dōu fēicháng chángjiàn
are very common at Chinese scenic spots nowadays,

而且很多看起来都很像
érqiě hěn duō kànqǐlai dōu hěn xiàng
and a lot of them look very much alike.

但好在今天是周一
dàn hǎozài jīntiān shì zhōuyī
But luckily, today is Monday.

和以前周末来旅游不一样
hé yǐqián zhōumò lái lǔyóu bùyīyàng
Unlike the weekend trips I used to take,

人少很多
rén shǎo hěn duō
there are far fewer people.

但也不是特别特别少
dàn yě bùshì tèbié tèbié shǎo
Though not extremely few, either.

所以对我来说就有一种刚刚好的氛围
suǒyǐ duìwǒláishuō jiù yǒu yīzhǒng gānggang hǎo de fēnwéi
So for me there's a just-right atmosphere.

那像这样一条老街
nà xiàng zhèyàng yī tiáo lǎojiē
An old street like this one

现在就主要是传统
xiànzài jiù zhǔyào shì chuántǒng
is now mainly a mix of traditional

民居和一些商铺饭店
mínjū hé yīxiē shāngpù fàndiàn
houses and some shops, restaurants

民宿的结合
mínsù de jiéhé
and guesthouses.

有很多民宿
yǒu hěn duō mínsù
There are lots of guesthouses.

他们一楼是咖啡厅或者酒吧
tāmen yī lóu shì kāfēitīng huòzhě jiǔbā
Their ground floor is a café or a bar,

二楼三楼或者更高的
èr lóu sān lóu huòzhě gèng gāo de
and the second, third or higher

楼层就是住宿的地方
lóucéng jiùshì zhùsù de dìfāng
floors are where you stay.

和很多地方一样
hé hěn duō dìfāng yīyàng
As in many places,

这里的星巴克也建成了
zhèlǐ de xīngbākè yě jiànchéng le
the Starbucks here has also been built

和当地建筑风格匹配的样子
hé dāngdì jiànzhù fēnggé pǐpèi de yàngzi
to match the local architectural style.

包括麦当劳也是
bāokuò màidāngláo yě shì
The McDonald's too.

在我的印象中
zài wǒ de yìnxiàng zhōng
As I remember it,

肯德基做的本地化的尝试
kěndéjī zuò de běndìhuà de chángshì
KFC's attempts at localization

其实是比麦当劳更多的
qíshí shì bǐ màidāngláo gèng duō de
are actually more numerous than McDonald's.

但我觉得这样的建筑设计应该也是
dàn wǒ juéde zhèyàng de jiànzhù shèjì yīnggāi yě shì
But I think this kind of architectural design must also be

麦当劳做的一个本地化的尝试吧
màidāngláo zuò de yígè běndìhuà de chángshì ba
one of McDonald's attempts at localizing.

你们看这里有一个小小的装饰
nǐmen kàn zhèlǐ yǒu yígè xiǎoxiǎo de zhuāngshì
Look, there's a little decoration here.

这个写的是篆书
zhège xiě de shì zhuànshū
This is written in seal script.

我大概能认出来
wǒ dàgài néng rènchū lái
I can just about make it out —

它写的就是“西津渡码头”
tā xiě de jiùshì "xī jīn dù mǎtóu"
it says "Xijindu Wharf".

这边有一座雕塑
zhèbiān yǒu yī zuò diāosù
There's a sculpture over here.

我觉得应该就是以前码头的
wǒ juéde yīnggāi jiùshì yǐqián mǎtóu de
I think it must be modelled on

码头的船夫的样子
mǎtóu de chuánfū de yàngzi
the boatmen of the old wharf.

这一块特别安静
zhè yīkuài tèbié ānjìng
This corner is especially quiet.

这里眼前就是一片绿意
zhèlǐ yǎnqián jiùshì yī piàn lǜ yì
Right in front of us is a stretch of green.

如果我们看到眼前有
rúguǒ wǒmen kàn dào yǎnqián yǒu
When we see before us

一大片绿色的植物
yī dàpiàn lùsè de zhíwù
a great expanse of green plants,

一大片绿色的自然的景观
yī dàpiàn lùsè de zìrán de jǐngguān
a great expanse of green natural scenery,

我们就可以说眼前有一片绿意
wǒmen jiù kěyǐ shuō yǎnqián yǒu yī piàn lǜ yì
we can say there's "a stretch of green" before our eyes.

这是比较诗意的说法
zhè shì bǐjiào shīyì de shuōfa
It's a rather poetic way of putting it.

但是古街我今天想带你们就看到这里
dànshì gǔ jiē wǒ jīntiān xiǎng dài nǐmen jiù kàn dào zhèlǐ
But that's as much of the old street as I'll show you today.

现在我要去一个我更期待的地方
xiànzài wǒ yào qù yígè wǒ gèng qīdài de dìfāng
Now I'm off to a place I'm looking forward to even more,

也希望是一个更安静的地方
yě xīwàng shì yígè gèng ānjìng de dìfāng
and hopefully a quieter one too.

好的，现在我们到了
hǎo de, xiànzài wǒmen dàoliǎo
All right, we've arrived.

我们今天的第二个地方
wǒmen jīntiān de dìèr gè dìfāng
This is our second stop today.

这个地方叫焦山
zhège dìfāng jiào jiāo shān
This place is called Jiaoshan — Jiao Mountain.

就是后面那座山
jiùshì hòumiàn nà zuò shān
It's that mountain behind me.

我们现在要等渡船过来
wǒmen xiànzài yào děng dùchuán guòlai
Now we have to wait for the ferry

接我们去那座山
jiē wǒmen qù nà zuò shān
to take us over to the mountain.

其实镇江有三座比较有名的山
qíshí zhènjiāng yǒu sān zuò bǐjiào yǒumíng de shān
Zhenjiang actually has three fairly famous mountains,

但是我选这里是因为这座山
dànshì wǒ xuǎn zhèlǐ shì yīnwèi zhè zuò shān
but I chose this one because it's

是唯一一座在长江中的山
shì wéiyī yī zuò zài chángjiāng zhòngdì shān
the only one standing in the Yangtze River.

它被江水环绕
tā bèi jiāngshuǐ huánrào
It's surrounded by the river water,

所以我觉得比较特别
suǒyǐ wǒ juéde bǐjiào tèbié
which I find rather special

比较吸引我
bǐjiào xīyǐn wǒ
and rather appealing.

那也有的人把这座山叫做“江中浮玉”
nà yě yǒude rén bǎ zhè zuò shān jiàozuò "jiāng zhōng fú yù"
Some people also call this mountain "Jade Afloat in the River",

就是浮在江中的一块玉
jiùshì fú zài jiāng zhòngdì yīkuài yù
meaning a piece of jade floating on the river.

可以看到现在渡船向我们开过来了
kěyǐ kàn dàoxiànzài dùchuán xiàng wǒmen kāi guòlai le
You can see the ferry heading our way now.

现在我们上船啦
xiànzài wǒmen shàngchuán la
Now we're going aboard.

现在准备靠岸
xiànzài zhǔnbèi kàoàn
We're about to dock.

现在我们到焦山门口了
xiànzài wǒmen dào jiāo shānmén kǒu le
Now we're at the entrance to Jiaoshan.

这就是大门口
zhè jiùshì dàmén kǒu
This is the main gate.

上面从右往左写着“焦山胜境”
shàngmiàn cóng yòu wǎng zuǒ xiě zhe "jiāo shān shèng jìng"
Above it, written right to left, is "Jiaoshan Shengjing".

“胜境”一般就是用来形容一个特别好
"shèng jìng" yībān jiùshì yònglái xíngróng yígè tèbié hǎo
"Shengjing" is generally used to describe a place that is especially fine,

特别美的地方
tèbié měidí dìfāng
especially beautiful.

你们应该会注意到很多中国
nǐmen yīnggāi huì zhùyì dào hěn duō zhōngguó
You've probably noticed that many Chinese

的景区都有这样的石狮子
de jǐngqū dōu yǒu zhèyàng de shíshīzi
scenic areas have stone lions like these.

其实是一对
qíshí shì yīduì
They actually come as a pair,

一公一母
yī gōng yī mǔ
one male and one female.

母狮子的脚下一般都有一头小狮子
mǔ shīzi de jiǎoxià yībān dōu yǒu yītóu xiǎo shīzi
Under the female lion's paw there's usually a cub,

而公狮子的脚下一般都会踩着一个球
ér gōng shīzi de jiǎoxià yībān dūhuì cǎi zhe yígè qiú
while the male lion usually has a ball under his.

这边还有更多石雕的狮子
zhèbiān háiyǒu gèng duō shídiāo de shīzi
Over here there are even more carved stone lions.

撅着屁股的狮子
juē zhe pìgu de shīzi
Lions with their rear ends stuck up in the air.

现在我们进了山
xiànzài wǒmen jìn le shān
Now that we're inside the mountain,

因为有了树荫
yīnwèi yǒule shùyìn
with the shade of the trees,

终于感觉凉快多了
zhōngyú gǎnjué liángkuai duō le
it finally feels much cooler.

这边还有一个佛学院
zhèbiān háiyǒu yígè fóxué yuàn
There's a Buddhist academy over here too.

再往前走就是一座寺庙
zài wǎngqián zǒu jiùshì yī zuò sìmiào
A little further on there's a temple.

这座寺庙叫定慧寺
zhè zuò sìmiào jiào dìng huì sì
This temple is called Dinghui Temple.

有三个石桥通向它
yǒu sānge shí qiáo tōngxiàng tā
Three stone bridges lead up to it,

定慧寺后面又有一座塔
dìng huì sì hòumiàn yòu yǒu yī zuò tǎ
and behind Dinghui Temple there's a pagoda.

现在我进来
xiànzài wǒ jìnlái
Now that I've come inside,

整体的感受就是
zhěngtǐ de gǎnshòu jiùshì
my overall impression is that

整个景区非常有层次
zhěnggè jǐngqū fēicháng yǒu céngcì
the whole place has a wonderful sense of layers.

走进来一层又一层的
zǒujìn lái yīcéng yòu yīcéng de
You walk in and there's layer after layer,

每一个地方都是景色
měiyī gè dìfāng dōu shì jǐngsè
and every single spot is a view in itself.

这些都是用来烧香的
zhèxiē dōu shì yònglái shāoxiāng de
These are all for burning incense.

但可能因为今天是周一吧
dàn kěnéng yīnwèi jīntiān shì zhōuyī ba
But maybe because today is Monday,

没有什么人来烧香
méiyǒushénme rén lái shāoxiāng
hardly anyone has come to burn any.

你更多看到的是这里的
nǐ gèng duō kàn dào de shì zhèlǐ de
What you see more of are

工作人员或者一些僧侣走来走去
gōngzuòrényuán huòzhě yīxiē sēnglǔ zǒu lái zǒuqù
the staff here, or a few monks walking about.

游客很少
yóukè hěn shǎo
There are very few tourists.

你们看这个寺庙前面也有一对石狮子
nǐmen kàn zhège sìmiào qiánmiàn yě yǒu yīduì shíshīzi
Look — in front of this temple there's also a pair of stone lions,

只不过比我们刚刚在
zhǐbuguò bǐ wǒmen gānggang zài
only much smaller than the ones

门口看到的小多了
ménkǒu kàn dào de xiǎo duō le
we saw at the gate just now.

我们发现了一只非常亲人的小猫
wǒmen fāxiàn le yìzhī fēicháng qīnrén de xiǎomāo
We've found a very friendly little cat.

而且因为听说这上面有一些猫
érqiě yīnwèi tīngshuō zhè shàngmiàn yǒuyīxiē māo
And since I'd heard there were cats up here,

所以我提前准备了食物（猫粮）
suǒyǐ wǒ tíqián zhǔnbèi le shíwù (māo liáng)
I brought food with me in advance — cat food.

啊，等一下
a, děngyīxià
Ah, hold on.

我解不开
wǒ jiě bù kāi
I can't get it open.

但不知道他现在饿不饿
dàn bùzhī dào tā xiànzài è bù è
But I don't know whether he's hungry right now.

等一下哦
děngyīxià ó
Hang on a second.

他现在躺下来了
tā xiànzài tǎngxià lái le
He's lying down now,

非常放松
fēicháng fàngsōng
completely relaxed.

等一下哦
děngyīxià ó
Just a moment.

我就放一点吧
wǒ jiù fàng yīdiǎn ba
I'll only put out a little,

不然把这边的环境弄脏了
bùrán bǎ zhèbiān de huánjìng nòngzāng le
otherwise I'll make a mess of this place.

但我觉得这边的人
dàn wǒ juéde zhèbiān de rén
But I think the people here

应该也有在规律的喂它
yīnggāi yě yǒu zài guīlù de wèi tā
must be feeding him regularly as well.

看起来被养的挺好的
kànqǐlai bèi yǎng de tǐnghǎo de
He looks very well cared for.

吃完了
chīwán le
All finished.

很满足的样子
hěn mǎnzú de yàngzi
He looks thoroughly satisfied.

你想打招呼吗？
nǐ xiǎng dǎzhāohu ma?
Do you want to say hello?

哇，你们看这边有一个龙的造型的钟
wa, nǐmen kàn zhèbiān yǒu yígè lóng de zàoxíng de zhōng
Wow, look — there's a bell shaped like a dragon over here.

我猜应该是钟吧
wǒ cāi yīnggāi shì zhōng ba
I'm guessing it's a bell,

用来敲的
yònglái qiāo de
meant to be struck.

真的一个人都没有
zhēn de yīgèrén dōu méiyǒu
There really isn't a single person around.

我很少在寺庙有这样的体验
wǒ hěn shǎo zài sìmiào yǒu zhèyàng de tǐyàn
I've rarely had an experience like this at a temple.

看来以后真的要选工作日来寺庙
kànlai yǐhòu zhēn de yào xuǎn gōngzuòrì lái sìmiào
It seems I really should visit temples on weekdays from now on.

接下来我会安静的逛一会寺庙
jiēxiàlái wǒ huìān jìng de guàng yīhuì sìmiào
Next I'm going to wander the temple quietly for a while,

然后把相机关掉
ránhòu bǎ xiàngjī guāndiào
so I'll turn the camera off.

现在我走到景区更里面了
xiànzài wǒ zǒu dào jǐngqū gèng lǐmiàn le
Now I've walked deeper into the scenic area,

这边反而有更多人
zhèbiān fǎnér yǒu gèng duō rén
and there are actually more people here.

大家好像都在坐着乘凉休息
dàjiā hǎoxiàng dōu zài zuò zhe chéngliáng xiūxi
Everyone seems to be sitting in the shade, resting.

可能因为天气真的太热了吧
kěnéng yīnwèi tiānqì zhēn de tài rè le ba
Probably because the weather really is too hot.

你们看
nǐmen kàn
Take a look —

从这个角度看刚刚的
cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn gānggang de
from this angle, the temple and the stone bridges

寺院和石桥那一块好美啊
sìyuàn hé shí qiáo nà yīkuài hǎo měi a
we saw just now look so beautiful.

真的就像一幅画
zhēn de jiù xiàng yī fú huà
It really is just like a painting.

我们走近一点
wǒmen zǒujìn yīdiǎn
Let's go a bit closer.

这垂下来的树叶就像
zhè chuíxià lái de shùyè jiù xiàng
These drooping leaves are like

画框上的装饰一样
huàkuàng shàng de zhuāngshì yīyàng
decoration on a picture frame.

我没想到这边还有一个
wǒ méixiǎngdào zhèbiān háiyǒu yígè
I didn't expect there to be

碑林
bēilín
a forest of steles here as well.

这特别吸引我这样的书法爱好者
zhè tèbié xīyǐn wǒ zhèyàng de shūfǎ àihàozhě
That's especially appealing to a calligraphy lover like me.

让我们进去看一下
ràng wǒmen jìnqù kàn yīxià
Let's go in and take a look.

这一块碑是清代乾隆皇帝留下的
zhè yīkuài bēi shì qīngdài qiánlóng huángdì liúxià de
This stele was left by the Qianlong Emperor of the Qing dynasty.

哇，你们看阳光透过这一个
wa, nǐmen kàn yángguāng tòuguò zhè yígè
Wow, look at the sunlight coming through this

花窗打在地上的阴影
huā chuāng dǎ zàidì shàng de yīnyǐng
latticed window and the shadows it casts on the ground.

又一只小猫
yòu yìzhī xiǎomāo
Another little cat.

这只白猫比起我一般
zhè zhǐ bái māo bǐqǐ wǒ yībān
This white cat is much bolder

看到的白猫要大胆很多
kàn dào de bái māo yào dàdǎn hěn duō
than the white cats I usually meet.

一直闭着眼睛，打了个哈欠
yīzhí bìzhe yǎnjing, dǎ le gè hāqian
Eyes shut the whole time — and there's a yawn.

我没想到这座碑林这么大
wǒ méixiǎngdào zhè zuò bēilín zhème dà
I didn't expect this stele forest to be so big.

这里面还有一些石桌子石椅子
zhèlǐ miàn háiyǒu yīxiē shí zhuōzi shí yǐzi
Inside there are stone tables and stone stools,

还有一个像茶室一样的地方
háiyǒu yígè xiàng chá shì yīyàng de dìfāng
and a spot that looks like a teahouse.

整个碑林看起来就像一座小小的园林
zhěnggè bēilín kànqǐlai jiù xiàng yī zuò xiǎoxiǎo de yuánlín
The whole stele forest looks like a miniature garden.

没想到这里面还藏着一片竹林
méixiǎngdào zhèlǐ miàn hái cáng zhe yī piàn zhúlín
I didn't expect a bamboo grove to be tucked away in here either.

特别茂密的竹子
tèbié màomì de zhúzi
Wonderfully dense bamboo.

就好像突然会有一只熊猫出现一样
jiù hǎoxiàng tūrán huì yǒu yìzhī xióngmāo chūxiàn yīyàng
It feels as if a panda might suddenly appear.

这里面还有更多更多的碑刻
zhèlǐ miàn háiyǒu gèng duō gèng duō de bēikè
And in here there are many, many more stone inscriptions.

真是很安静的一片地呢
zhēnshi hěn ānjìng de yī piàn dì ne
It really is such a quiet little place.

那你们应该知道书法有不同的字体
nà nǐmen yīnggāi zhīdào shūfǎ yǒu bùtóng de zìtǐ
Now, you probably know that calligraphy has different scripts.

像这种比较规整的就是楷书
xiàng zhèzhǒng bǐjiào guīzhěng de jiùshì kǎishū
A neat, orderly one like this is regular script, kaishu.

这种笔画之间连起来的
zhèzhǒng bǐhuà zhījiān lián qilai de
This kind, with the strokes joined together,

你们可能有点看不懂的
nǐmen kěnéng yǒudiǎn kànbudǒng de
which you may find a little hard to read,

就叫行书
jiù jiào xíngshū
is called running script, xingshu.

如果连的不那么厉害
rúguǒ lián de bù nàme lìhai
If the strokes aren't joined quite so much,

我们也会叫行楷
wǒmen yě huì jiào xíng kǎi
we also call it xingkai — running-regular script.

还有像这样的刻画
háiyǒu xiàng zhèyàng de kèhuà
there are carved pictures like this one too.

这一位就是观音
zhè yī wèi jiùshì guānyīn
This figure is Guanyin,

对中国人来说很重要的神仙
duì zhōngguórén lái shuō hěn zhòngyào de shénxiān
a deity very important to Chinese people.

还有梅花的刻画
háiyǒu méihuā de kèhuà
And here's a carving of plum blossom.

它没有画一整棵树的梅花
tā méiyǒu huà yī zhěng kē shù de méihuā
Rather than depicting a whole tree in blossom,

而是画了其中的一枝
érshì huà le qízhōng de yī zhī
it shows just a single branch.

这么这么多的竹子
zhème zhème duō de zhúzi
So very much bamboo

真的让这个地方显得特别安静
zhēn de ràng zhège dìfāng xiǎnde tèbié ānjìng
really does make this place feel especially quiet.

如果可以
rúguǒ kěyǐ
If I could,

真希望在这边待一整个下午
zhēn xīwàng zài zhèbiān dài yī zhěnggè xiàwǔ
I'd love to spend a whole afternoon here.

而且这里面还特别凉快
érqiě zhèlǐ miàn hái tèbié liángkuai
And it's beautifully cool in here as well.

但是现在已经3点多了
dànshì xiànzài yǐjīng 3 diǎn duō le
But it's already past three o'clock,

然后从焦山回到市区的
ránhòu cóng jiāo shān huídào shìqū de
and the last ferry

渡船最晚的一班是5:45
dùchuán zuì wǎn de yī bān shì 5: 45
from Jiaoshan back to the city is at 5:45.

所以我现在要抓紧一点
suǒyǐ wǒ xiànzài yào zhuājǐn yīdiǎn
So I need to get a move on now

马上爬到山顶去看一下那座塔
mǎshàng pá dào shāndǐng qù kàn yīxià nà zuò tǎ
and climb straight to the summit to see that pagoda.

哎，人就是不能太贪心
āi, rén jiùshì bùnéng tài tānxīn
Ah, you really mustn't be too greedy.

就是如果想要像我这样慢慢走慢慢看
jiùshì rúguǒ xiǎngyào xiàng wǒ zhèyàng mànmàn zǒu mànmàn kàn
I mean, if you want to stroll and look slowly the way I do,

还给你们录视频的话
huángěi nǐmen lù shìpín dehuà
and film a video for you all as well,

应该早上八九点就过来的
yīnggāi zǎoshang bā jiǔ diǎn jiù guòlai de
you should come at eight or nine in the morning.

可是我太懒了起不来
kěshì wǒ tài lǎn le qǐ bù lái
But I'm too lazy to get up.

看到了吗
kàn dàoliǎo ma
Did you see that?

一只黑猫
yìzhī hēi māo
A black cat.

你在吃什么
nǐ zài chī shénme
What are you eating?

你在做什么呢
nǐ zài zuòshímǒ ne
What are you up to?

你的牙齿痒吗
nǐ de yáchǐ yǎng ma
Are your teeth itchy?

没想到这里还藏着一个盆景园
méixiǎngdào zhèlǐ hái cáng zhe yígè pénjǐng yuán
I never expected a bonsai garden to be hidden here too.

天呐
tiān nà
Oh my goodness.

你们可以告诉我焦山
nǐmen kěyǐ gàosu wǒ jiāo shān
Can you tell me — is there anything

还有什么地方是它没有的吗？
háiyǒu shénmedìfang shì tā méiyǒu de ma?
that Jiaoshan doesn't have?

这个地方真的值得逛一天
zhège dìfāng zhēn de zhíde guàng yìtiān
This place really is worth a whole day.

可惜我来的太晚了
kěxī wǒ lái de tài wǎn le
It's a shame I came so late

只能选择性的逛一逛
zhǐnéng xuǎnzéxìng de guàng yī guàng
and can only pick and choose what to see.

不过本来旅游就是有
bùguò běnlái lǔyóu jiùshì yǒu
Then again, travelling always means

一些地方要错过的嘛
yīxiē dìfāng yào cuòguò de ma
there are some places you have to miss.

现在这里应该就正式上山了
xiànzài zhèlǐ yīnggāi jiù zhèngshì shàngshān le
From here, I think, the climb officially begins.

我们走上台阶
wǒmen zǒu shàngtái jiē
Let's go up the steps.

说实话我第一次看到这样的标识
shuōshíhuà wǒ dìyīcì kàn dào zhèyàng de biāozhì
To be honest, it's the first time I've seen signs like these.

两个标识都是是告诉你上山
liǎng gè biāozhì dōu shì shì gàosu nǐ shàngshān
Both signs just tell you "up the mountain",

而不是去哪个地方
ér bùshì qù nǎge dìfāng
rather than where they actually lead.

不知道这样的标识是否真的有意义
bùzhī dào zhèyàng de biāozhì shìfǒu zhēn de yǒuyìyì
I wonder whether signs like this are any use at all.

那我们选择这条上山之路吧
nà wǒmen xuǎnzé zhè tiáo shàngshān zhī lù ba
Well then, let's take this path up the mountain.

爬山的时候
páshān de shíhou
When I'm climbing a mountain,

我特别特别喜欢这些
wǒ tèbié tèbié xǐhuan zhèxiē
I especially, especially love this

从树叶之间照下来的阳光
cóng shùyè zhījiān zhào xiàlai de yángguāng
sunlight streaming down through the leaves.

从这边可以看到市区
cóng zhèbiān kěyǐ kàn dào shìqū
From here you can see the city,

但是你能感觉到我们离市区很远
dànshì nǐ néng gǎnjuédào wǒmen lí shìqū hěn yuǎn
but you can feel how far away from it we are.

我们隔绝了市区的噪音啊
wǒmen géjué le shìqū de zàoyīn a
We're shut off from the city's noise

污染啊
wūrǎn a
and its pollution.

但我觉得这座山应该不太高
dàn wǒ juéde zhè zuò shān yīnggāi bù tài gāo
But I don't think this mountain is very tall.

很快就可以爬到山顶了
hěn kuài jiù kěyǐ pá dào shāndǐng le
We should reach the top before long.

这座亭子的名字很有意思
zhè zuò tíngzi de míngzi hěn yǒuyìsi
The name of this pavilion is rather interesting.

叫做“吸江楼”
jiàozuò "xī jiāng lóu"
It's called "Xijiang Lou" — the River-Drinking Tower.

这个就是“吸”
zhège jiùshì "xī"
This character here means "to draw in, to inhale",

好像这座亭子要把旁边的
hǎoxiàng zhè zuò tíngzi yào bǎ pángbiān de
as if this pavilion were going to drink up

长江的水全部吸进去一样
chángjiāng de shuǐ quánbù xījìn qù yīyàng
every drop of the Yangtze River beside it.

我感觉我到山顶了
wǒ gǎnjué wǒ dào shāndǐng le
I think I've made it to the top.

我觉得我的体力不如以前了
wǒ juéde wǒ de tǐlì bùrú yǐqián le
I feel my stamina isn't what it used to be.

可能因为前不久感染了新冠吧
kěnéng yīnwèi qiánbùjiǔ gǎnrǎn le xīn guān ba
Maybe because I caught COVID not long ago.

对身体的打击真的很大
duì shēntǐ de dǎjī zhēn de hěn dà
It really took a heavy toll on my body.

前面就是一座塔
qiánmiàn jiùshì yī zuò tǎ
Just ahead is a pagoda.

这座塔叫“万佛塔”
zhè zuò tǎ jiào "wàn fótǎ"
This pagoda is called "Wanfo Ta" — the Ten Thousand Buddhas Pagoda,

因为里面据说有一万尊佛像
yīnwèi lǐmiàn jùshuō yǒu yī wàn zūn fóxiàng
because it's said to hold ten thousand Buddha statues inside.

是重建的
shì chóngjiàn de
it's a reconstruction.

应该是有七层高
yīnggāi shì yǒu qī céng gāo
It should be seven storeys high.

我们在这边还可以
wǒmen zài zhèbiān hái kěyǐ
From here we can also

看到远处的江景和市区
kàn dào yuǎnchù de jiāng jǐng hé shìqū
see the river and the city in the distance.

但是这座万佛塔看起来好像不能进去
dànshì zhè zuò wàn fótǎ kànqǐlai hǎoxiàng bùnéng jìnqù
But it seems you can't go inside this Ten Thousand Buddhas Pagoda.

门上上了锁
mén shàng shàng le suǒ
The door is locked.

但我能通过这个门缝看到里面
dàn wǒ néng tōngguò zhège mén fèng kàn dào lǐmiàn
Still, I can see in through the crack in the door.

里面在施工
lǐmiàn zài shīgōng
There's construction going on inside.

难怪不能进去呢
nánguài bùnéng jìnqù ne
No wonder you can't go in.

现在下午4:15
xiànzài xiàwǔ 4: 15
It's now 4:15 in the afternoon,

我准备下山啦
wǒ zhǔnbèi xiàshān la
and I'm getting ready to head back down.

现在我们下来了
xiànzài wǒmen xiàlai le
Now we've come down

到江边了
dào jiāngbiān le
to the riverside.

在这里可以欣赏江景
zài zhèlǐ kěyǐ xīnshǎng jiāng jǐng
From here you can take in the river view.

虽然已经下午4点多了
suīrán yǐjīng xiàwǔ 4 diǎn duō le
Even though it's already past four in the afternoon,

但是太阳还是挺晒的
dànshì tàiyang háishi tǐng shài de
the sun is still pretty fierce.

但说实话
dàn shuōshíhuà
But to be honest,

从这这座江中小山往
cóng zhè zhè zuò jiāng zhōng xiǎo shān wǎng
the view looking out into the distance

远处看的景色并不怎么好
yuǎnchù kàn de jǐngsè bìngbù zěnme hǎo
from this little mountain in the river isn't all that special —

因为它自己本身就是江上最好的景色
yīnwèi tā zìjǐ běnshēn jiùshì jiāng shàng zuìhǎo de jǐngsè
because the mountain itself is the best view on the river.

en_cues.text:
hello大家好。好久好久不见了
Hello everyone. It's been a long, long time.

我好久好久没有录vlog了
I haven't recorded a vlog in ages.

那这几天
So, these past few days

我在进行一个短途旅行
I've been on a short trip.

我在镇江
I'm in Zhenjiang.

这个地方在上海的西北部
This place is northwest of Shanghai.

离上海坐火车大概只要一个半小时
It's only about an hour and a half from Shanghai by train.

我住的酒店就在镇江
The hotel I'm staying at is right next to

最著名的一个景点旁边
Zhenjiang's most famous scenic spot.

这个景点叫做西津渡
This spot is called Xijindu — West Ferry Crossing.

在古代是一个渡口
In ancient times it was a ferry crossing,

所以镇江在古代其实挺重要的
so Zhenjiang was actually quite important back then.

但我猜你们现在应该
But I'd guess that these days

没有多少人听过这个城市
not many of you have heard of this city.

所以今天我就想带你们一起看一看
So today I want to take you along to have a look.

西津渡现在是一个
Xijindu is now a place

像商业古街一样的地方
rather like a commercial old street.

其实这样的古街
Actually, old streets like this

现在在中国很多景点都非常常见
are very common at Chinese scenic spots nowadays,

而且很多看起来都很像
and a lot of them look very much alike.

但好在今天是周一
But luckily, today is Monday.

和以前周末来旅游不一样
Unlike the weekend trips I used to take,

人少很多
there are far fewer people.

但也不是特别特别少
Though not extremely few, either.

所以对我来说就有一种刚刚好的氛围
So for me there's a just-right atmosphere.

那像这样一条老街
An old street like this one

现在就主要是传统
is now mainly a mix of traditional

民居和一些商铺饭店
houses and some shops, restaurants

民宿的结合
and guesthouses.

有很多民宿
There are lots of guesthouses.

他们一楼是咖啡厅或者酒吧
Their ground floor is a café or a bar,

二楼三楼或者更高的
and the second, third or higher

楼层就是住宿的地方
floors are where you stay.

和很多地方一样
As in many places,

这里的星巴克也建成了
the Starbucks here has also been built

和当地建筑风格匹配的样子
to match the local architectural style.

包括麦当劳也是
The McDonald's too.

在我的印象中
As I remember it,

肯德基做的本地化的尝试
KFC's attempts at localization

其实是比麦当劳更多的
are actually more numerous than McDonald's.

但我觉得这样的建筑设计应该也是
But I think this kind of architectural design must also be

麦当劳做的一个本地化的尝试吧
one of McDonald's attempts at localizing.

你们看这里有一个小小的装饰
Look, there's a little decoration here.

这个写的是篆书
This is written in seal script.

我大概能认出来
I can just about make it out —

它写的就是“西津渡码头”
it says "Xijindu Wharf".

这边有一座雕塑
There's a sculpture over here.

我觉得应该就是以前码头的
I think it must be modelled on

码头的船夫的样子
the boatmen of the old wharf.

这一块特别安静
This corner is especially quiet.

这里眼前就是一片绿意
Right in front of us is a stretch of green.

如果我们看到眼前有
When we see before us

一大片绿色的植物
a great expanse of green plants,

一大片绿色的自然的景观
a great expanse of green natural scenery,

我们就可以说眼前有一片绿意
we can say there's "a stretch of green" before our eyes.

这是比较诗意的说法
It's a rather poetic way of putting it.

但是古街我今天想带你们就看到这里
But that's as much of the old street as I'll show you today.

现在我要去一个我更期待的地方
Now I'm off to a place I'm looking forward to even more,

也希望是一个更安静的地方
and hopefully a quieter one too.

好的，现在我们到了
All right, we've arrived.

我们今天的第二个地方
This is our second stop today.

这个地方叫焦山
This place is called Jiaoshan — Jiao Mountain.

就是后面那座山
It's that mountain behind me.

我们现在要等渡船过来
Now we have to wait for the ferry

接我们去那座山
to take us over to the mountain.

其实镇江有三座比较有名的山
Zhenjiang actually has three fairly famous mountains,

但是我选这里是因为这座山
but I chose this one because it's

是唯一一座在长江中的山
the only one standing in the Yangtze River.

它被江水环绕
It's surrounded by the river water,

所以我觉得比较特别
which I find rather special

比较吸引我
and rather appealing.

那也有的人把这座山叫做“江中浮玉”
Some people also call this mountain "Jade Afloat in the River",

就是浮在江中的一块玉
meaning a piece of jade floating on the river.

可以看到现在渡船向我们开过来了
You can see the ferry heading our way now.

现在我们上船啦
Now we're going aboard.

现在准备靠岸
We're about to dock.

现在我们到焦山门口了
Now we're at the entrance to Jiaoshan.

这就是大门口
This is the main gate.

上面从右往左写着“焦山胜境”
Above it, written right to left, is "Jiaoshan Shengjing".

“胜境”一般就是用来形容一个特别好
"Shengjing" is generally used to describe a place that is especially fine,

特别美的地方
especially beautiful.

你们应该会注意到很多中国
You've probably noticed that many Chinese

的景区都有这样的石狮子
scenic areas have stone lions like these.

其实是一对
They actually come as a pair,

一公一母
one male and one female.

母狮子的脚下一般都有一头小狮子
Under the female lion's paw there's usually a cub,

而公狮子的脚下一般都会踩着一个球
while the male lion usually has a ball under his.

这边还有更多石雕的狮子
Over here there are even more carved stone lions.

撅着屁股的狮子
Lions with their rear ends stuck up in the air.

现在我们进了山
Now that we're inside the mountain,

因为有了树荫
with the shade of the trees,

终于感觉凉快多了
it finally feels much cooler.

这边还有一个佛学院
There's a Buddhist academy over here too.

再往前走就是一座寺庙
A little further on there's a temple.

这座寺庙叫定慧寺
This temple is called Dinghui Temple.

有三个石桥通向它
Three stone bridges lead up to it,

定慧寺后面又有一座塔
and behind Dinghui Temple there's a pagoda.

现在我进来
Now that I've come inside,

整体的感受就是
my overall impression is that

整个景区非常有层次
the whole place has a wonderful sense of layers.

走进来一层又一层的
You walk in and there's layer after layer,

每一个地方都是景色
and every single spot is a view in itself.

这些都是用来烧香的
These are all for burning incense.

但可能因为今天是周一吧
But maybe because today is Monday,

没有什么人来烧香
hardly anyone has come to burn any.

你更多看到的是这里的
What you see more of are

工作人员或者一些僧侣走来走去
the staff here, or a few monks walking about.

游客很少
There are very few tourists.

你们看这个寺庙前面也有一对石狮子
Look — in front of this temple there's also a pair of stone lions,

只不过比我们刚刚在
only much smaller than the ones

门口看到的小多了
we saw at the gate just now.

我们发现了一只非常亲人的小猫
We've found a very friendly little cat.

而且因为听说这上面有一些猫
And since I'd heard there were cats up here,

所以我提前准备了食物（猫粮）
I brought food with me in advance — cat food.

啊，等一下
Ah, hold on.

我解不开
I can't get it open.

但不知道他现在饿不饿
But I don't know whether he's hungry right now.

等一下哦
Hang on a second.

他现在躺下来了
He's lying down now,

非常放松
completely relaxed.

等一下哦
Just a moment.

我就放一点吧
I'll only put out a little,

不然把这边的环境弄脏了
otherwise I'll make a mess of this place.

但我觉得这边的人
But I think the people here

应该也有在规律的喂它
must be feeding him regularly as well.

看起来被养的挺好的
He looks very well cared for.

吃完了
All finished.

很满足的样子
He looks thoroughly satisfied.

你想打招呼吗？
Do you want to say hello?

哇，你们看这边有一个龙的造型的钟
Wow, look — there's a bell shaped like a dragon over here.

我猜应该是钟吧
I'm guessing it's a bell,

用来敲的
meant to be struck.

真的一个人都没有
There really isn't a single person around.

我很少在寺庙有这样的体验
I've rarely had an experience like this at a temple.

看来以后真的要选工作日来寺庙
It seems I really should visit temples on weekdays from now on.

接下来我会安静的逛一会寺庙
Next I'm going to wander the temple quietly for a while,

然后把相机关掉
so I'll turn the camera off.

现在我走到景区更里面了
Now I've walked deeper into the scenic area,

这边反而有更多人
and there are actually more people here.

大家好像都在坐着乘凉休息
Everyone seems to be sitting in the shade, resting.

可能因为天气真的太热了吧
Probably because the weather really is too hot.

你们看
Take a look —

从这个角度看刚刚的
from this angle, the temple and the stone bridges

寺院和石桥那一块好美啊
we saw just now look so beautiful.

真的就像一幅画
It really is just like a painting.

我们走近一点
Let's go a bit closer.

这垂下来的树叶就像
These drooping leaves are like

画框上的装饰一样
decoration on a picture frame.

我没想到这边还有一个
I didn't expect there to be

碑林
a forest of steles here as well.

这特别吸引我这样的书法爱好者
That's especially appealing to a calligraphy lover like me.

让我们进去看一下
Let's go in and take a look.

这一块碑是清代乾隆皇帝留下的
This stele was left by the Qianlong Emperor of the Qing dynasty.

哇，你们看阳光透过这一个
Wow, look at the sunlight coming through this

花窗打在地上的阴影
latticed window and the shadows it casts on the ground.

又一只小猫
Another little cat.

这只白猫比起我一般
This white cat is much bolder

看到的白猫要大胆很多
than the white cats I usually meet.

一直闭着眼睛，打了个哈欠
Eyes shut the whole time — and there's a yawn.

我没想到这座碑林这么大
I didn't expect this stele forest to be so big.

这里面还有一些石桌子石椅子
Inside there are stone tables and stone stools,

还有一个像茶室一样的地方
and a spot that looks like a teahouse.

整个碑林看起来就像一座小小的园林
The whole stele forest looks like a miniature garden.

没想到这里面还藏着一片竹林
I didn't expect a bamboo grove to be tucked away in here either.

特别茂密的竹子
Wonderfully dense bamboo.

就好像突然会有一只熊猫出现一样
It feels as if a panda might suddenly appear.

这里面还有更多更多的碑刻
And in here there are many, many more stone inscriptions.

真是很安静的一片地呢
It really is such a quiet little place.

那你们应该知道书法有不同的字体
Now, you probably know that calligraphy has different scripts.

像这种比较规整的就是楷书
A neat, orderly one like this is regular script, kaishu.

这种笔画之间连起来的
This kind, with the strokes joined together,

你们可能有点看不懂的
which you may find a little hard to read,

就叫行书
is called running script, xingshu.

如果连的不那么厉害
If the strokes aren't joined quite so much,

我们也会叫行楷
we also call it xingkai — running-regular script.

不仅有刻字
There aren't only carved characters;

还有像这样的刻画
there are carved pictures like this one too.

这一位就是观音
This figure is Guanyin,

对中国人来说很重要的神仙
a deity very important to Chinese people.

还有梅花的刻画
And here's a carving of plum blossom.

它没有画一整棵树的梅花
Rather than depicting a whole tree in blossom,

而是画了其中的一枝
it shows just a single branch.

这么这么多的竹子
So very much bamboo

真的让这个地方显得特别安静
really does make this place feel especially quiet.

如果可以
If I could,

真希望在这边待一整个下午
I'd love to spend a whole afternoon here.

而且这里面还特别凉快
And it's beautifully cool in here as well.

但是现在已经3点多了
But it's already past three o'clock,

然后从焦山回到市区的
and the last ferry

渡船最晚的一班是5:45
from Jiaoshan back to the city is at 5:45.

所以我现在要抓紧一点
So I need to get a move on now

马上爬到山顶去看一下那座塔
and climb straight to the summit to see that pagoda.

哎，人就是不能太贪心
Ah, you really mustn't be too greedy.

就是如果想要像我这样慢慢走慢慢看
I mean, if you want to stroll and look slowly the way I do,

还给你们录视频的话
and film a video for you all as well,

应该早上八九点就过来的
you should come at eight or nine in the morning.

可是我太懒了起不来
But I'm too lazy to get up.

看到了吗
Did you see that?

一只黑猫
A black cat.

你在吃什么
What are you eating?

你在做什么呢
What are you up to?

你的牙齿痒吗
Are your teeth itchy?

没想到这里还藏着一个盆景园
I never expected a bonsai garden to be hidden here too.

天呐
Oh my goodness.

你们可以告诉我焦山
Can you tell me — is there anything

还有什么地方是它没有的吗？
that Jiaoshan doesn't have?

这个地方真的值得逛一天
This place really is worth a whole day.

可惜我来的太晚了
It's a shame I came so late

只能选择性的逛一逛
and can only pick and choose what to see.

不过本来旅游就是有
Then again, travelling always means

一些地方要错过的嘛
there are some places you have to miss.

现在这里应该就正式上山了
From here, I think, the climb officially begins.

我们走上台阶
Let's go up the steps.

说实话我第一次看到这样的标识
To be honest, it's the first time I've seen signs like these.

两个标识都是是告诉你上山
Both signs just tell you "up the mountain",

而不是去哪个地方
rather than where they actually lead.

不知道这样的标识是否真的有意义
I wonder whether signs like this are any use at all.

那我们选择这条上山之路吧
Well then, let's take this path up the mountain.

爬山的时候
When I'm climbing a mountain,

我特别特别喜欢这些
I especially, especially love this

从树叶之间照下来的阳光
sunlight streaming down through the leaves.

从这边可以看到市区
From here you can see the city,

但是你能感觉到我们离市区很远
but you can feel how far away from it we are.

我们隔绝了市区的噪音啊
We're shut off from the city's noise

污染啊
and its pollution.

但我觉得这座山应该不太高
But I don't think this mountain is very tall.

很快就可以爬到山顶了
We should reach the top before long.

这座亭子的名字很有意思
The name of this pavilion is rather interesting.

叫做“吸江楼”
It's called "Xijiang Lou" — the River-Drinking Tower.

这个就是“吸”
This character here means "to draw in, to inhale",

好像这座亭子要把旁边的
as if this pavilion were going to drink up

长江的水全部吸进去一样
every drop of the Yangtze River beside it.

我感觉我到山顶了
I think I've made it to the top.

我觉得我的体力不如以前了
I feel my stamina isn't what it used to be.

可能因为前不久感染了新冠吧
Maybe because I caught COVID not long ago.

对身体的打击真的很大
It really took a heavy toll on my body.

前面就是一座塔
Just ahead is a pagoda.

这座塔叫“万佛塔”
This pagoda is called "Wanfo Ta" — the Ten Thousand Buddhas Pagoda,

因为里面据说有一万尊佛像
because it's said to hold ten thousand Buddha statues inside.

但它已经不是原来的塔了
But it's no longer the original pagoda;

是重建的
it's a reconstruction.

应该是有七层高
It should be seven storeys high.

我们在这边还可以
From here we can also

看到远处的江景和市区
see the river and the city in the distance.

但是这座万佛塔看起来好像不能进去
But it seems you can't go inside this Ten Thousand Buddhas Pagoda.

门上上了锁
The door is locked.

但我能通过这个门缝看到里面
Still, I can see in through the crack in the door.

里面在施工
There's construction going on inside.

难怪不能进去呢
No wonder you can't go in.

现在下午4:15
It's now 4:15 in the afternoon,

我准备下山啦
and I'm getting ready to head back down.

现在我们下来了
Now we've come down

到江边了
to the riverside.

在这里可以欣赏江景
From here you can take in the river view.

虽然已经下午4点多了
Even though it's already past four in the afternoon,

但是太阳还是挺晒的
the sun is still pretty fierce.

但说实话
But to be honest,

从这这座江中小山往
the view looking out into the distance

远处看的景色并不怎么好
from this little mountain in the river isn't all that special —

因为它自己本身就是江上最好的景色
because the mountain itself is the best view on the river.
